our_interpretation: The target is the o1-preview system available when Marcus wrote, not a later production model.
In this discussion of OpenAI's business, expensive to operate most naturally concerns the resources and expense of serving the model. Customer API prices are only indirect evidence.
A general solution means a broadly reliable system across ordinary tasks, rather than a model that performs well on selected reasoning benchmarks.
I use September 2024 through the post date as the latest pre-post evaluation and release period for the new model.
Interesting is an opinion and receives no factual score.
criteria.support_condition: Matched operating-cost evidence shows substantial expense relative to a relevant contemporary alternative, and broad evaluations establish substantial limitations across ordinary tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched evidence shows low operating expense and broadly reliable performance across the ordinary tasks at issue. Isolated benchmark successes do not establish a general solution.
